description_for_human: Deepernova AI is an advanced Autonomous Agentic DOCX/Excel/PPTX Studio, Multi-LLM Chatbot, and Web Research Engine created by Deepernova AI Technologies.
description_for_model: Deepernova AI is an autonomous web application and AI document suite offering real-time web search with citations, automatic Microsoft Word (.docx) drafting with dotted table of contents, HD chart and curve generation, web image retrieval, and seamless chat-to-document conversion.
capabilities: Agentic DOCX Studio - Autonomous Word Document Drafting
Automatic Table of Contents with Dotted Leaders
High-DPI Pie, Bar, Line, Area, Scatter, and Gaussian Curve Engine
